title: Getafe 0-3 Atletico Madrid: Simeone makes LaLiga history in dominant win
subtitle: Atletico Madrid kept pace with Real Madrid and Barcelona by sweeping aside Getafe, with Diego Simeone also breaking a LaLiga record.
paragraphs: Diego Simeone made LaLiga history as he led Atletico Madrid to a comfortable 3-0 victory over 10-man Getafe on Sunday, claiming his 345th triumph in the competition.
Simeone's victory saw him break the all-time LaLiga win record, surpassing Luis Aragones' 344 victories in 756 matches, with the Atletico boss achieving the feat in his 567th game in the top flight.

Atletico did the damage in a dominant first half that saw Alex Baena and Johnny Cardoso both hit the target before Alejandro Grimaldo converted a stoppage-time penalty after Djene Dakonam was sent off for a last-man foul on Alexander Sorloth.
Atletico edged in front with 10 minutes on the clock when Julian Alvarez laid the ball back for Baena to strike, with his crisp, low drive beating David Soria from 25 yards out.

The visitors should have doubled their lead moments later when Alvarez was sent through on goal, but Soria stood tall to thwart his effort before the Getafe goalkeeper produced a superb stop to deny the Argentine's curling 18th-minute attempt.
But Alvarez was involved in Atletico's second on the half-hour mark. His inviting corner caught Soria in no man's land, gifting Cardoso the simplest of finishes from close range.
Atletico's momentum continued after the break, with Baena's deflected shot calling Soria into action before Martin Satriano fired a glorious chance over the bar at the other end.

Simeone's side added further gloss to the scoreline in the 92nd minute when Sorloth was pushed in the back and off balance by Dakonam, with the Getafe captain dismissed for his needless challenge. Grimaldo stepped up to confidently dispatch the spot-kick and seal the victory.
Brilliant Baena impresses in dominant first half

With Barcelona and Real Madrid securing dramatic wins ahead of Atletico's clash, Simeone's and his players knew claiming all three points was a must, and they came out of the blocks in blistering fashion that laid the foundations for their 10th league win of the season.

Atletico had seven shots on target in the first 45 minutes and generated an expected goals (xG) total of 2.46. No other first half of an away LaLiga match has had as many shots on target (Getafe also had seven in October 2014) or more xG with Simeone in charge.

Baena got the ball rolling with a brilliant finish, which was his fourth goal from outside the box in the top flight in 2026-27, more than any other player in the competition. The Spaniard also has the highest goal tally of any Atletico player after the team's first 13 matches of a single top-flight campaign since 2003-04.

The result saw Atletico extend their winning run away from home in LaLiga to five matches, doing so for only the third time after April 2014 (five) and February 2021 (five), while they also ended Getafe's unbeaten eight-game stretch at the Estadio Coliseum.

Atletico bumped up their xG up to 4.11 from their 20 shots, 10 of which were on target, and they will be looking to use the victory as momentum ahead of a must-win clash with Viking in the Champions League on Wednesday.
